correctness.rationale: The generator is explicit including probe-only jumps. The unique stationary distribution has a strict quadratic Lyapunov drift and enough moments. Closed linear stationary degree-two/four balances produce an exact two-time cubic-plus-linear semigroup. The initial H derivative equals M40/2>0. The slow eigenvalue of the linear block is -z, and the cubic block is strictly faster by global quartic Routh–Hurwitz conditions; all six inequalities are verified after a positive-parameter transform. Exact algebra identifies slow residue L and its polynomial numerator. Descartes yields exactly one root in physical range and every denominator factor has a certified fixed sign. Standalone script rederives these identities from the generator. Only eventual signs and long-mode boundary are claimed; critical next-order and low-bath intermediate lags remain unproved.

originality.rationale: An exact fourth-order stationary two-time orientation-difference and a unique threshold for its slow-mode sign are not stated in the inspected primary source on this same two-coordinate probe-only reset model, which instead gives one-time stationary mixed moments, second-moment relaxation, and kurtosis. The 2024/2025 renewal bath-reset work concerns a different reset mechanism and ordinary second-order correlations. Published mathematical findings and literature searches did not expose a dominating claim. The contribution is the specific time-arrow residue, its strict spectral separation, and its model-dependent sign boundary; generic semigroup machinery is not asserted as novel. Uninspected general work remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The lag-antisymmetric fourth-order statistic is a natural stationary irreversible-time diagnostic not inferable from a symmetric covariance or one-time kurtosis. It has a forced sign reversal at a quantitatively sharp, finite bath-relaxation ratio despite strictly overdamped microscopic evolution. The analytical threshold gives an experimentally interpretable long-delay distinction for resetting with retained environmental memory; determining it uses nontrivial global spectral and root-sign arguments rather than substitution in a known variance formula.
